# Independent review - PR 583 @ 2168cc4b3b8a455619b7b3f6bc77686d32c8e3d0

## Findings
<!-- findings:begin -->
- none
<!-- findings:end -->

## Review

Scope: full main-relative diff at the published head against
`dcbcdf0396022e450d08254154ecb1812efbc1e2`, not just author checkpoint
`c5bc58672e045d7c11e94eb3a1c732c7a1211845`. Exactly one 194-line audit
is added: `audits/2026-09-12_issue-513_direct-error-absorption.md`. No Lean,
blueprint, other audit, or telemetry path changes in the main-relative patch.
This is preservation of the PR #545 historical record, not new mathematics.

Code-lane disposition: no changed Lean declarations or proof obligations to
certify. The original 172-line suffix (8,867 bytes) matches the blob at the
same path in original PR #545 head
`2f8f5cc4631db2db23f76513a2f7f56dffc8fa4f` byte-for-byte by `cmp` and
SHA-256 (`ef4a98d5350b756dd33db46eb7d475d76a1b660a89423a66d1f7bb38c9c8c501`).
The 22-line YAML/historical preface parses, dates the archived record,
identifies #513 and #545, and distinguishes its old proof-hole, construction,
validation, and cost assertions from current mathematical status. The former
missing path is cited in the existing composition audit at line 30; the
successor audit records subsequent closure. The paper's `lem:qld-4-7` at
`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1404`
states the global polynomial-pair goal; current `Apply.lean` contains its
construction. This review neither re-proves nor newly certifies that theorem.
The archived audit retains its original incomplete-construction narrative and
additive predecessor costs without pretending they are current conclusions.
The composition audit records the failed second-attempt handoff; the session
registry records `status: failed`, `exit: 1`, `usage: null`, and
`usage_scope: unknown` for `prover-513-20260912-02`. Unknown usage was not
converted to zero.

Prose-lane disposition: the full new audit and the linked historical and
successor records were read. The historical-status preface prevents the
original `notready` and remaining-obligations text from presenting itself as
the present state. There are no changed blueprint entries, Lean docstrings,
`\lean`, `\leanok`, `\notready`, or `\uses` tags to reassess. Existing
source-paper and blueprint status are not modified by this PR.

Validation and limits: main-relative `git diff --name-status`, `--stat`, and
`--check` pass; PyYAML `safe_load` confirms metadata and 22+172 line division;
Git-object suffix comparison passes. The full file is 9,905 bytes and has
SHA-256 `a8eb0189d502c84ebacfdcff9582291272abd0b7c05d1851be8c15df04779e78`.
Exact-head `local-ci/summary` and all nine `local-ci/*` contexts are green;
the document-only gate skips are not a new Lean build or blueprint render.
No build, mathematical proof attempt, PR #545 retirement, issue #513 closure,
status publication, or merge was performed. PR #465's merge priority is
unaffected. The admission snapshot and live API inspection show no earlier PR
review; the sole conversation comment is the local-CI manifest. Trusted
instructions were read from published main
`62791d20c4c5243775b5596eaa52077f7d811c32`, never from the reviewed
branch. This reviewer did not author the diff or its earlier receipts.

VERDICT: APPROVED
